title: Adaptive Hosted Inference Surface PRD — chat/completions/embeddings/rerank with hybrid rerank & rollout checklist
creator: Maya Chen
summary: PRD to deliver an adaptive hosted inference surface that consolidates chat, completions, embeddings and rerank endpoints under a single route with per-request policy hints (latency/cost/quality) and a hybrid rerank pipeline combining semantic embeddings and fast rule-based filters. Includes detailed acceptance criteria and a launch readiness checklist.
background: Customers repeatedly request a single, predictable API that can handle conversational and scoring workloads with clear cost/latency tradeoffs. Existing surface fragmentation requires multiple endpoints and client-side glue. This PRD defines an adaptive surface that exposes a unified endpoint while preserving per-model performance controls and enabling a new hybrid rerank capability.
goals: 1) Provide a single API for chat, completions, embeddings and rerank that developers can adopt without rewriting clients. 2) Support per-request policy hints (latency/cost/quality) that select routing and quantization profiles. 3) Launch hybrid rerank (semantic+exact) with default safe thresholds. 4) Ensure rollout with canary gating, telemetry and rollback criteria to meet SLOs.
non_goals: 1) Replacing long-term on-prem dedicated routing orchestration. 2) Supporting non-text modalities in this launch. 3) Full auto-tuning of batching policies (will be a follow-up).
user_stories: Developer wants a single POST /v1/inference request to produce chat completions or scalar embeddings based on a small mode field without client-side switching.
As a platform engineer I want per-request policy hints so workloads can prefer low-latency quantized variants for interactive chat.
As a search engineer I want rerank to return top-K with both semantic and exact-match signals and an explainability token for why each item scored higher.
requirements: API: New /v1/inference route that accepts 'mode': one of ['chat','completion','embedding','rerank'] and optional 'policy_hints':{'latency':'low'|'balanced'|'high','cost':'low'|'balanced'|'high','quality':'low'|'balanced'|'high'}. (policy_hints encoded as flat keys in request body for compatibility).
Models: Ability to route to model variant families (e.g., redwood-1.0, redwood-quant) based on policy_hints and regional capacity.
Embeddings: Embedding responses must include 'vector' and 'norm' fields; service normalizes vector length when 'normalize':true is supplied.

Rerank pipeline: Stage 1 exact-match filter (configurable boolean), Stage 2 semantic scoring via embeddings, Stage 3 optional reweight with signals passed in 'features' array. Return per-item score breakdown when 'explain':true.
SDKs: JS + Python SDKs must expose the new route and serialize policy hints in a backward-compatible manner. SDKs must default to 'balanced' if hints omitted.
Telemetry: Emit tokenized latency, model_variant, policy_hints, routing_decision, and rerank_score_breakdown for each request.
SLOs: P99 end-to-end latency for 'chat' with latency hint 'low' <= 200ms for up to 50 RPS sustained on dedicated pools; error rate <= 0.5%.
Billing: Tag usage by mode and model_variant for accurate per-token or per-embedding billing lines in invoices.
acceptance_criteria: API contract exists in OpenAPI spec and tests validate schema compatibility with existing endpoints.
End-to-end integration tests for each mode (chat/completion/embedding/rerank) passing in CI with mocked model backends.
Performance: Benchmarks show median token latency for 'chat' balanced <= 350ms and cost per token within 10% of baseline for common prompts.
Rerank quality: On internal benchmark set (20 queries x 200 candidates) hybrid rerank improves NDCG@10 by >= 5% vs semantic-only baseline.
Telemetry: Dashboard shows per-mode traffic, P95/P99 latency, model_variant splits, and canary gating metrics populated.
SDKs: JS and Python SDK releases published, with at least one integration example in docs and one sample app migrated.
Security: Security review completed and key audit items (KMS for private deployments, no PII leaked into logs) signed off.
Launch Readiness: All checklist items marked complete and at least two production customers in private preview.
success_metrics: Adoption: 25% of new hosted API users (signups in 30 days post-launch) use the unified /v1/inference route.
Cost: Average cost per 1k tokens for balanced chat use cases reduced by >= 7% through routing and caching improvements.
Quality: Regression tests show < 1% quality regressions across tracked prompt set for embeddings and rerank.
Reliability: Platform meets SLOs for 99.9% of traffic in the first 30 days post-launch.
rollout_plan: Phase 0 - Internal dogfooding: limited to internal apps and Redwood examples for 2 weeks.
Phase 1 - Private previews: invite 2 enterprise customers (support team assigned) for 3 weeks with feedback board.
Phase 2 - Canary: 1% of eligible hosted API traffic with strict canary gating on errors, latency, and quality signals for 72 hours.
Phase 3 - Gradual ramp: increase to 10% over 7 days, 50% over 14 days, with automatic rollback on failure thresholds.
Phase 4 - Broad launch: flip default in SDKs and public docs; monitor first 72 hours with on-call rotations expanded.
launch_checklist: OpenAPI spec updated and reviewed: PR # (link) in API repo.
Server-side integration tests merged and green in main CI.
Load/perf benchmarks uploaded to perf dashboard and reviewed by infra.
JS & Python SDKs released with migration notes and backward compatibility tests.
Docs: Quickstart, migration guide, rerank recipe, and API reference published to docs site.
Console: New per-route dashboard card exposing policy_hints split, model_variant, and rerank breakdown.
Billing: Invoicing team confirmed mode/model_variant tagging and price matrix updated.
Security: Security review checklist closed, KMS integration tested in private deployment.
Observability: Traces, logs, and metric keys documented; alert runbooks updated with rollback thresholds.
Support: Support runbook and triage playbook created; post-launch escalation owners assigned.
Legal/Compliance: Terms updated if needed; data residency opt-in toggles validated.
Customer comms: Release notes drafted, migration guide emailed to existing power users and partners.
risks: Performance regression risk when routing to quantized variants — mitigated by conservative default routing and load testing.
Rerank explainability may expose tokens that reveal sensitive data — mitigated by redaction rules and security review.
SDK breakage for edge clients unaware of 'mode' field — mitigated by backward-compatible defaults and deprecation window.
Billing misattribution if tagging not applied consistently — mitigate with end-to-end invoice spot checks before launch.
